verdict_reason: Sentinel-1/2 and EuroCrops are fully open (GEE/Zenodo). No EU source publishes which organic-soil parcels were actually rewetted and when: CRCF Union Registry is EU-Login-gated, methodology only adopted Jul 2026; MoorFutures/LIFE pages give no parcel geodata. Labels must be hand-built from fragmented national records; LPIS access varies by member state.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 GRD (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD)
sources.licence_quote: The use of Sentinel data is governed by the Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions.
sources.coverage_quote: Global coverage (geographic extent: -90 to 90 latitude, -180 to 180 longitude)

sources.name: Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A Harmonized (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED)
sources.licence_quote: The use of Sentinel data is governed by the Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions.
sources.coverage_quote: Wide-swath, high-resolution, multi-spectral imaging for land monitoring

sources.name: EuroCrops (Zenodo)
sources.licence_quote: Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International
sources.coverage_quote: 16 EU countries: Austria, Belgium, Germany, Denmark, Estonia, Spain, France, Croatia, Lithuania, Latvia, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Sweden, Slovenia, Slovakia
sources.date_range: 2018-2021 depending on country (e.g. Austria 2021, France 2018, Denmark 2019)
caveats_quoted: Self-reported crop-type data, single reference year per country; not a rewetting-event or multi-date time series

sources.name: Land Parcel Identification System (LPIS)
sources.coverage_quote: A system to identify land use for a given country; utilises orthophotos, aerial photographs and high precision satellite images
caveats_quoted: No dedicated LPIS open data portal found; official EU LPIS page 404'd; access is managed per member-state paying agency, not centrally published

sources.name: EU Union Registry (CRCF carbon-farming certification)
caveats_quoted: Page requires EU Login (CAS) authentication; redirected to sorry.ec.europa.eu, content not retrievable without login

sources.name: MoorFutures (German peatland-rewetting carbon-certificate programme)
sources.coverage_quote: Links to four German state programmes (Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Brandenburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Niedersachsen)
caveats_quoted: No public map or registry of rewetted parcels with geospatial boundaries and dates found on this page

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Match LPIS parcel IDs to national programme project lists (MoorFutures, LIFE Peat Restore) for rewetting dates; confirm each via visual interpretation of pre/post Sentinel-1 wetness and Sentinel-2 phenology time series.
ground_truth.label_count_estimate: Unknown; likely tens to low hundreds of documented parcels across MoorFutures state programmes plus LIFE Peat Restore sites, not a systematic EU-wide count

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD + COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED catalogs), free hosted compute
compute_path.why: Sentinel-1/2 stacks process natively in GEE free hosted compute; no local GPU or multi-day training needed, fits MacBook-no-CUDA/part-time constraint.

queries.q: Sentinel-1 GRD Google Earth Engine catalog dataset
EU CRCF Carbon Removals and Carbon Farming registry rewetted peatland parcels published
queries.note: confirmed no parcel-level public registry described in secondary sources; session WebSearch budget exhausted after this, remaining verification done via direct WebFetch

notes: Biggest blocker: ground-truth path. No systematic, publicly accessible EU dataset tags which organic-soil parcels were rewetted/when. CRCF Union Registry requires EU Login; peatland certification methodology adopted Jul 2026, not yet operational with historical parcel data. National schemes (MoorFutures, LIFE Peat Restore) publish project-level, not parcel-level, info. LPIS is not centrally open; access is per member-state paying agency.
